text_block_list.text:
The day of the Satsuki Sho—the first
race of the
Classics—arrives, but Narita
Brian feels some
dissatisfaction at only
being able to race against
runners in the
same year as her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
At that moment, Хиши Амадзон steps up
to
challenge her, having already claimed
the first
tiara of the Tiara tour.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Listening to Хиши Амадзон, Нарита Брайан
realizes
the significance of being able to
participate in
once-in-a-lifetime races.
She prepares herself
mentally for the
experience.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
